Metadata.title: Seydullah Kaya — Freelance Software Developer
Metadata.description: Freelance software developer building business websites, web applications and mobile apps.

Common.whatsappMessage: Hi Seydullah, I found you through your website. I'd like to talk about a project.

Hero.description: I'm Seydullah, a computer engineer and freelance software developer. From business websites to web and mobile apps, I turn your idea into fast, reliable and maintainable products.

About.title: Solid engineering, simple products.
paragraphs: I'm a computer engineer building web and mobile products for businesses. Before writing any code, I make sure I understand your business and your users, then choose the architecture and technology that fit those needs.

I write readable, type-safe and testable code, and I treat performance and security as requirements from day one. After launch I stay on board, keeping the product growing with maintenance and new features.
About.workStyleNote: I usually reply to messages within 24 hours.

Services.title: From idea to launch, end to end.
Services.description: From a single landing page to a full-scale application, I support you at every stage.

website.title: Business websites
website.description: Modern websites that tell your brand's story, load fast and get found on search engines.

webapp.title: Web applications
webapp.description: Scalable, custom web apps such as dashboards, booking and management systems.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.description: Smooth mobile apps running on both iOS and Android from a single codebase.

maintenance.title: Maintenance & development
maintenance.description: Ongoing support to keep your existing site or app up to date, secure and fast.

Footer.title: Let's build something together.
Footer.description: Have a project in mind? Tell me about it and I'll get back to you shortly.
